Summarize the following notes in at most 45 words. Report only what the notes state.

Engine build 0.4.1 notes. The loader now rejects a model file whose tensor inventory does not match the manifest. Cancellation was changed so an interrupted request leaves the engine reusable. The default context stays at 8192 tokens; the 16384-token path remains gated on a memory receipt. Prefix caching is still disabled by default.

key_facts: loader rejects a tensor inventory mismatch

messages.content:
Summarize the memo below in at most 60 words, preserving every number it reports.

Workspace memo, week 12. The team recorded 4 crashes on the CPU backend and 0 on the accelerated backend. Median first-token latency fell from 820 ms to 610 ms after the prefill change. Tool output is now capped at 64 KiB per call. Two open questions remain: whether the 16384-token path fits the memory guard, and whether the accelerated backend silently falls back to CPU under load. No release date was agreed.

key_facts: median first-token latency fell from 820 ms to 610 ms
tool output capped at 64 KiB per call
